name: Kenji Tanaka
bio:
Kenji Tanaka's journey into motorsport began unexpectedly. A graduate of Tokyo Institute of Technology with a degree in Statistics, he initially pursued a career in finance. However, a chance visit to a Super GT race ignited a passion that quickly consumed him. He started volunteering at a local racing team, offering his analytical skills to improve their race strategy. His meticulous approach and ability to extract meaningful insights from complex data sets led him to Manthey Racing.

At Manthey Racing, Kenji focuses on pre-race simulation and post-race data analysis. He meticulously examines telemetry data, weather patterns, and competitor performance to identify areas where the team can gain an edge. He's known for his calm demeanor under pressure and his ability to communicate complex data in a clear and concise manner. He believes in leveraging data to make informed decisions, ensuring the team consistently optimizes its performance.

What sets Kenji apart is his dedication to continuous learning and improvement. He constantly explores new analytical techniques and technologies, striving to refine his methodology and provide Manthey Racing with a competitive advantage. He frequently collaborates with the engineering team, providing data-driven insights that directly contribute to vehicle setup and race strategy.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed with a slight receding hairline.
physical.description: Kenji is of average height with a slender build and a focused gaze.

quirks: Insists on drinking green tea before every analysis session.
Uses color-coded sticky notes to organize data printouts.
